finding.finding: Verified: Divulapitiya site S18 equipment is not working; road R18 between Minuwangoda and Divulapitiya is closed. No grid-power or backhaul status is established.

S18 equipment is verified faulty and the direct route R18 is verified closed. The catalog includes an equipment repair at S18 and a generator deployment at S18; no backhaul fault is resolved. Crews have required equipment and generator skills, and C2 has backhaul skill. The closed R18 affects the S17–S18 route, but alternative access may be possible; no listed fact establishes that S18 work is unsafe or impossible. Generator G2 is reported unavailable, while G1 is available at DEPOT. Road status and alternative access to S18 should be confirmed before planning travel.

questions.question: Is R18 still closed, and is there a safe alternative road route for crews to reach S18?
Is generator G2 currently unavailable, and if so, when is it expected to be serviceable?

finding.finding: S18 (Divulapitiya, service V18) is the only service with an authoritative equipment failure. Its grid power is confirmed available, but the site equipment is down; the failed R18 road also blocks access from S17. V18 is policy-designated critical (weight 5), so this outage matters most under the approved weights. All other listed services have no confirmed outage in the supplied resolved state. The Minuwangoda–Divulapitiya road-closure bulletin corroborates an access constraint; the unconfirmed social post does not establish a repair.
